description: Loaned to the Indian Air Force as JI-008 before returning to RAF service, ending as a ground instructional airframe at FCSTE Manston in 2005. Sold to Jet Art Aviation at Thorpe Wood in December 2020 and moved to Chippenham Lodge on 10 July 2024. Wears 16 Squadron special markings. Last recorded present May 2026.
aliases: Jaguar GR3A; JaguarGR3A; XX116; JI-008; JI008

description: Air-defence variant trials aircraft coded AT1, last flown June 2004, later at Boscombe Down and with Jet Art Aviation at Thorpe Wood before preservation at Chippenham Lodge. Displayed outdoors in a black scheme with 43 Squadron markings and falsely marked ZG757. Last recorded present May 2026.

Delivered October 1998, stored at Shawbury from 2006 and used for ground instruction at SFDO Culdrose from 2009, moving to Thorpe Wood in January 2021 and to Chippenham Lodge in 2022. Displayed outdoors in a black scheme with 801 NAS markings and the code 002. Last recorded present May 2026.
aliases: Sea Harrier FA2; SeaHarrierFA2; F/A2; ZH811
